mechanism: strong 1h price-channel thrust -> first EMA20 pullback -> confirmed 1h return with trend

frozen_rules.trend: EMA20(close)>EMA50(close) and EMA20(close) rising on completed bar
frozen_rules.strong_thrust: close_t>max(high[t-20:t]) and trend, at completed bar t
frozen_rules.first_pullback: within first 8 completed 1h bars AFTER thrust; low<=EMA20 and close>EMA50 and EMA20>EMA50
frozen_rules.resume: within next 8 completed 1h bars AFTER first pullback; completed close_t>high[t-1] AND close_t>EMA20 AND trend
frozen_rules.entry: NEXT completed 1h bar OPEN after resume signal; model-only, cannot claim actual boundary quote
frozen_rules.exit: NEXT 1h bar OPEN after first completed close<EMA20 or after completed 24h holding bars, whichever comes first
frozen_rules.max_per_symbol: 1 open long only; no short/no DCA/pyramid; first impulse memory reset after trade ends
frozen_rules.no_leakage: no next bar high/low/close in signal; next bar open is simulated price
frozen_rules.comparator: PREDECLARED first impulse immediate NEXT 1h OPEN, same trend and exit rules; chronology/occupancy not forced equal
frozen_rules.testing: single unmodified rule per frozen 6 symbols and both fixed chronological windows, no grid search
